context.transcript:
Will the lawyer provide
A. paper copy of the agreement or send it by email? A. We've had better sales results this quarter.
B. Do you have a preference?
C. Yes, I saw that too.
context.transcript_translation:
律师会提供
A. 是提供协议的纸质副本还是通过电子邮件发送？ A. 我们这个季度销售结果更好。
B. 你有偏好吗？
C. 是的，我也看到了。

items.question: Will the lawyer provide
